summary: WP-010 code-review PASS. Seven new Core-layer bookmark domain files are well-designed. ISP correctly applied across three repository interfaces. Bookmark.Favorite exclusion is documented. UpdateAsync contract is explicit. All nullable field choices in Bookmark.cs are correct. One documentation-forward: BookmarkBrowserQuery.MinRating doc is ambiguous about MinRating=0 vs null behavior.

comments.note: No blocking observations. Interface Segregation Principle is correctly applied: IBookmarkBrowserRepository (read-only paged browser access) is cleanly separated from IBookmarkRepository (full CRUD). The IBookmarkRepository.GetAllDescriptionsAsync method correctly returns 'distinct non-empty' strings — the 'non-empty' filter is an important design detail since Description is a nullable/empty string that should not pollute auto-complete lists. All nullable field choices in Bookmark.cs are correct (ThumbnailPath = no thumbnail yet; LastClicked = never activated).

[documentation-forward] BookmarkBrowserQuery.MinRating XML doc is ambiguous about the behavior when MinRating = 0 vs MinRating = null. Both would logically return all ratings (since rating >= 0 matches everything), but this is undocumented. The doc should clarify whether MinRating = 0 is treated identically to null, or whether it explicitly excludes only invalid/negative ratings. This affects how implementors write the WHERE clause and how callers use the API.
